name: Age-Gated Densification (AGE)
definition: An add-on for 3D Gaussian Splatting that improves reconstruction quality by combining two components: DART (Distance-Aware Replication) which augments the initial point cloud with distance-dependent replicas, and AGE (Age-Gated Densification) which acts as a maturity gate to prune unnecessary primitives during training.
summary: Age-Gated Densification is a static maturity gate that delays 3D Gaussian Splatting densification until a threshold, pruning unnecessary primitives to reduce memory and time costs without degrading quality.
